name: Build an expressive Three.js generative dreamscape
prompt: Create the interactive Three.js experience in CREATIVE_BRIEF.md. Deliver index.html, styles.css, scene.js, and DESIGN_NOTES.md. Use Three.js through an import map or documented package setup, create an original spatial composition with intentional camera movement, lighting, materials, and interaction, and provide a graceful reduced-motion/static fallback. Keep performance and resize behavior in mind. Human reviewers will judge the live experience and source; there is no automated aesthetic score.
